summary: Keep dogfooded local-read and MCP surfaces read-only, bounded, and mapped to real Postscript endpoints.
reason: Postscript QA found the same non-live failure classes called out on adjacent PRs: local read commands opened SQLite in write/migration mode, analytics materialized all records before applying --limit, MCP SQL could return unbounded rows, generic import assumed /<resource> paths that Postscript does not expose, and review cleanup found an exposed no-op batch flag plus an uncapturable local-read warning.
validated_outcome: go test ./internal/cli ./internal/mcp ./internal/store passes, analytics reads a seeded SQLite store through OpenReadOnly, MCP SQL envelopes rows under the tool result budget, import dry-run accepts only events at /api/v2/events, --batch-size is hidden until implemented, and local unfiltered warnings route through hintWriter.
